items.note: The derivation follows the proof: net change (JV+RG)x independent of scratch, central coefficients |S∩T| mod 2 and (|S∩T|-1)/2 cancelled by side wires, then (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x). But the plan never gives h=100, N, m=h^3, the two neighbour rules or the wire counts W_b, W_c, and S2.3's 'undoing the first step' loosely describes rows 6-7.

S2.5 states the identity D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} with frames common to a gate commuting with pointwise gates, and says only edge frame changes cost work. It is a single infer step with no sub-steps for the vertex invariant. The per-route form appears only in its later uses (S2.10.3.2, S2.8.4).

Correct conclusions: only central 3->4 edges decrease, each by h, L=Ich, sum of |Δdim| = Wm-2N+2L, and the ratios 100/539 and 101/539. But the label space F^{⊗3}, its bilinear forms and the orthogonality of neighbouring triple lines (which makes the side edge 2->5 increasing) are never stated, the residual table is only asserted in S2.6.2, and the F_2 orthonormal-basis part is not derived.

Follows the proof step by step: rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, the N first edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b with deficit N-2L_b>0, and the endpoint difference P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m giving H<-H+D on every role.

It reproduces the paper's route: weight additivity mod 4 for orthogonal vectors, the phase i^{ε[v·x]} rewritten as the kernel aI+bX_v, s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c, and the Z_{a,k} and i^{27k} corrections giving C^{⊗mk}. The final negation of the X outputs and the undoing of rho are only implicit.
Gives L/N<1/2, both deficits, the exact η_b and η_c above 20·2^{-50}, log m<20, the inequality m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20·2^{-50})>m(1-η), and s/W<m^τ with τ=σ=1-2^{-50}, all as in the paper.

S2.1 lists the four O(V) operations correctly. S2.2's claim leaves out the hypotheses: the offset must be preparable in b^{O(1)} time, and the units must be fixed rationals with denominators and numerators prime to q. Only the quoted line carries the first. No proof steps are given.

Correct factorization (pivoting on the topmost nonzero row and its rightmost entry), O(V) triangular transforms in descending order, conjugation by E_1 and E_2, and one interchange per one of Π. The choice of a fixed odd prime q avoiding the table's denominators is not mentioned.

Every step of the proof is present: cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W, Φ_{I_m} on every role, the three-shear interchange, exactly s calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric sum with the a<=1 case, and the depth-first parking schedule.
Follows the proof: ρ high digits joined into a row field q^{2ρ}>=W^k, padding to R'<2R, the base-m decomposition of e-ρ summing to O(Ve^τ), and binary padding to [q^e] giving O(Vu^τ).

Has the conjugation P_M X_v P_M^{-1}=X_{Mv} with M only invertible, the inverse child (C^{-1})^{⊗f}=(-i)^f Z C Z, exactly s_c children on f=e/m axes, and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D. The Gaussian-elimination count of row additions is reduced to 'a fixed number'.

Has the eight ±1 operations and their parity cycles, the guard interval and union bound giving δ_bad, T_0 S_0^{-1} permuting B and repaired by radix sort, sixteen swaps and eight rotations, and the o(1) extra terms. The separate XOR at j_{f-1} is omitted, and the method's 'segments separated by guard bits' is loose.

Follows the paper's sequence: node overhead O(V((eK)^τ+1)), the q_0 row chunks padded to a multiple of W^{k_0}, children of volume V/W, the recurrence with leaves O(e) for e<d^β, the internal sum O(e^λ), the leaf bound O(e^σ d^{β(1-σ)}), and the base-m pieces giving O(d^{λ'}).

States the exact layer with one truncation in O(Vd^{λ'}). Derives the depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, the bound A(e)<=8B^2 d^{ν+1}, the guard width Δ=⌈C_0 d^{C_1}⌉=o(p), and error below √2·2^{-p} from absolute row sum one.

Covers ω_t=y^{2r/t}, character cancellation via the shift giving y^{rj_0}=-1, decimation in frequency into bit-reversed slots, the reverse procedure giving F^+B^{-1}, the grouped monomial J_E, the layout L with its three cost terms, and the error bound √2·ℓ·2^{-p} from J_E Q_p = Q_p J_E.

Follows the proof: evaluation at B_0=2^{4p} with carries in {-1,0}, |h_j|<B_0/2, centered extraction with carry in {0,1}, numerators ac-be and ae+bc reduced mod y^r+1, and four products in O(rp log(rp)).
Has the normalization F^-(f*g)=M(F^-f)(F^-g), the commutation P(LBu,LBv)=LB P(u,v), the error 2δ+η then 3δ+η scaled by M, and the cost with M=T/r products.

The route matches: the cited identity TP_sF_s=P_tF_tS, ||N-I||<1/2 for θ>p/α^4, normalizations multiplying to 2^{-2α^2}, the routine errors 16p, 3p^2/4 and 4, the tensor form with γ=2dα^2, error dp^2 and axis moves O(Tpd^2(1+ℓ^τ)). But the retained permutations (P_s u)_j=u_{tj} and (P_t v)_k=v_{-sk}, and coprimality, are never defined.
Has the chirp coefficient computation identifying QF_t, F_q^+R_c=R_c^{-1}F_q^+, RF_s^+R=F_s^+, the convolution rule giving (u*v)/S^2, and the conjugation trick.

Sizes, comparison bands, the prime count from the cited interval bound, T/2<S<T by Bernoulli, α^4θ_i>p, trial division in n^{o(1)}, and no wraparound are all derived as in the paper. But the fixed list omits λ=1-2^{-52} and δ=1/16, and α=⌈(12d^2b)^{1/4}⌉ is used without being defined.
Covers the isomorphism Φ with μ_i=P_i^{-1}, the triangular formula for b_i and why it holds, updates in order i=d..1 preserving the padding, and the cost O(Tpd^2(1+ℓ^τ)), all as in the paper.
Has the diagonal isomorphism, the wrap check ζ^{k+l}(-1)^h=ζ^j, and M_C=D_- ι^{-1} M_r(ι D_+ f, ι D_+ g)=(f*g)/T. The computed twists, each with error below 4, enter through S6.13.3.

The source-transform composition giving RF_s, the conjugate opposite procedure, and the six algorithm steps with the two roles of S are all present. But the digit scale 2^{-b-2} is never given ('scaled digit streams'), and S6's headline lists the second scale as 2^{2b+4} rather than 2^{2b+4}S.

The paper's error chain is reproduced: E_ring<5TL, 6TL, 8TL, E_s=9·2^γ·TL, the product error (2E_s+2), the opposite error (3E_s+2), E_w<28·2^γ·T^2·L, and the final bound 448b·2^{-3b/4}<1/2. The carry bounds are included.

Correct margins g_1..g_7 with min 2^{-181}=2κ, the row derivations, polylog absorption, and the cutoff. But the paper's argument that setup across all visits and exceptional-address sorting cost o(V) (lines 4908-4975) is missing; only the per-call packed terms (S2.11.5.5) and the prime search (S6.2.4) appear.
S0 only lists nlogn-conjecture among its prerequisites. No step states the eventual lower bound, its negation via liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0, or that the bound gives limit zero.

errors.says: Subtracting the effect of the unknown scratch contents, adding the real contribution and then undoing the first step changes the target by (JV+RG)x.
errors.paper: Rows 0-1 subtract Ja+Rc, rows 2-3 change the scratch to a+Vx, c+Gx, rows 4-5 add R(c+Gx)+J(a+Vx), and rows 6-7 undo gather and copy to restore c,a. The initial subtraction is not undone; it cancels the old-scratch part of rows 4-5.

errors.says: the sum of edge dimension changes is Wm-2N+2L
errors.paper: The signed dimension changes sum to Wm-2N. It is the sum of absolute changes that equals Wm-2N+2L (S2.6.1 and S2.6.4 state this correctly).

errors.says: Perform the XORs as packed integer additions of K-bit segments separated by guard bits
errors.paper: The K-bit segments starting at j_i are contiguous (j_{i+1}=j_i+K). The guard value g_i is the segment's own upper K-1 bits (u_i=2g_i+a_i), not separate bits between segments, and the updates are eight conditional ±1 cyclic shifts.

The first scale is by S and the second by 2^{2b+4}S, so S occurs twice: once undoing the normalization (u*v)/S^2 and once with 2^{2b+4} undoing the two input scales. S6.10 and S6.12 state this correctly.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route from the fixed bank-exchange network, through frames, labels, the rank budget s<Wm and the exponent τ=σ=1-2^{-50}, to the two recursions (chunk interchange and the simultaneous layer). It continues through transforms, convolution, resampling, CRT, exact recovery and the margin table to O(n(lg n)^{1-κ}). It thins in three places: the network's parameters (h=100, N, m=h^3) and the label space with orthogonal neighbouring triple lines are never given, so the comparability of labels is asserted rather than shown; and the final total omits the o(V) bound on setup and exceptional-address sorting across all calls.

steps.note: The exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a), with banks indexed by triples of 3-subsets and every scratch wire restored, is fully derived. But h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are never given, and N and m are used undefined. Conservatively, the network's defining data are incomplete.
S2.5: an invertible frame common to each gate commutes with pointwise linear gates, so the network implements D_out S_Ω D_in^{-1} and only edge frame changes cost work.

Gates and terminals get nested nondegenerate subspaces of an m-dimensional space built from triple indicator lines, and the only decreasing edges are the central wires from time 3 to 4, each losing h (removing P⊗F⊗Q). F^{⊗3} and neighbour orthogonality are left implicit.
S2.7.1: rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested nondegenerate labels. S2.7.2: the N source edges 2P_{U_a} have rank one although their dimension change is zero.
Sum of absolute changes = Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich (S2.6.4), and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b (S2.7.3).
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, so the deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0, hence s<Wm.
The endpoint difference P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m, zero source and identity sink on other roles, so Φ_{I_m}: H<-H+D on every role, including scratch rows.
A=E_1ΠE_2, triangular steps O(V), one interchange per one of Π, so exactly a interchanges plus O(V). Edges call rank(A_e) recursive interchanges, s in total.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^τ with τ=1-2^{-50} from η>20·2^{-50} and log m<20, hence F_k=O(e^τ).

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the central saving almost completely: frames, nested labels with the single decreasing edge class, rank equal to dimension change with the N rank-one source exceptions, the budget Wm-2N+2L, the strict deficit from L/N<1/2, the endpoint identity, edges as recursive interchanges, and the recurrence with τ=1-2^{-50}. The one gap is at C1: the network's exchange and restoration are derived, but its size parameters h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are never given.
